accepted_scientific_premise.evidence: 8/13 teacher atoms, all 7/7 frozen control atoms retained, e6.a recovered, full page-ceiling fraction
accepted_scientific_premise.constraint: The accepted lexical token-F1 >=0.40 certificate remains frozen and is not retuned post hoc.

exclusion_evidence.implication: A model can discriminate scientific entailment adequately yet still fail safe redundancy calibration; sentence-pair NLI confidence is not sufficient evidence for proposition redundancy.

exclusion_evidence.evidence: FOBIE scientific IE work reports Open IE performs poorly on long/complex scientific sentences and that 65% of erroneous/uninformative Open IE extractions could be filtered by narrow IE.
exclusion_evidence.implication: Do not use unconstrained OpenIE triples as the next evidence representation.

evidence: Ge et al., INLG 2024 show that fine-grained predicate-argument semantic tuples can serve as explicit coverage targets for extractive summarization.
spaCy en_core_web_sm 3.8.0 exposes deterministic dependency labels needed to derive bounded predicate/argument units and is MIT licensed.
FOBIE provides held-out scientific sentences with relation indicators and arguments, allowing domain-faithfulness testing before EXTRACT.
strengths: Keeps the successful direct-preservation idea but moves from whole-proposition overlap to explicit information-bearing units.
No autoregressive generation is required for the first validation.
External validation can independently test redundancy safety and scientific relation fidelity.
risks: Dependency parses are trained on general-domain data and can degrade on scientific syntax.
A hand-defined unit extractor can overgenerate or miss nominal/embedded relations.
Lexical component matching may still miss paraphrastic equivalence.

evidence: AMR captures predicate-argument semantics in graph form.
Bai et al., EMNLP 2022 report cross-domain AMR parsing challenges arising from distribution shifts in words and AMR concepts.
Clinical-domain AMR work requires explicit domain adaptation, reinforcing the domain-transfer risk.
strengths: Richer semantic representation than dependency tuples.
Can preserve relations beyond local surface structure.
risks: Adds a larger parser and graph-matching subsystem before simpler evidence units are exhausted.
Cross-domain parser error becomes a new semantic-preservation failure mode.
External validation and execution cost are materially higher.

research_comparison.reason: Published scientific-text evidence directly reports weak behavior on long/complex scientific sentences and high erroneous/uninformative extraction rates.

selected_validation.purpose: Validate a bounded dependency-derived predicate/argument evidence-unit representation independently of EXTRACT teacher labels before it may replace the accepted lexical certificate in any EXTRACT experiment.

evidence_unit_extraction.predicate_eligibility: A content token is eligible if dep is ROOT or it has at least one direct child in the frozen argument dependency set.
evidence_unit_extraction.argument_span: Use the full dependency subtree of the direct argument child, trimmed to non-punctuation tokens.
evidence_unit_extraction.negation: Attach direct neg child surface/lemma to the predicate signature.
evidence_unit_extraction.normalization: Lowercase lemmas; discard punctuation/space; preserve argument dependency labels; no stopword deletion inside argument spans.
evidence_unit_extraction.truncation_rule: If more than 12 eligible units exist, retain earliest predicate token offsets; ties by normalized tuple string.

redundancy_score.unit_similarity: 0.50 * token_f1(predicate_signature_A, predicate_signature_B) + 0.50 * mean over arguments in A of max token_f1(argument_text_A, argument_text_B), matching arguments without replacement by descending token_f1.
redundancy_score.directional_proposition_coverage: Mean over units in source proposition of maximum unit_similarity to a unit in target proposition.

pair_construction.positive: unordered distinct-text span pairs in the same proposition cluster
pair_construction.negative: unordered distinct-text span pairs from different proposition clusters within the same topic
pair_construction.negative_sampling: deterministically retain at most 5 negatives per positive by SHA256(pair identity), separately per split
pair_construction.topic_split: Sort topic IDs by SHA256(topic_id); first half calibration, second half held-out evaluation.

external_validation_sets.calibration_rule: Choose the lowest mutual-coverage threshold in the frozen grid with precision >=0.95 and recall >=0.05. If none exists, validation is rejected.

external_validation_sets.relation_recovery: A gold trade-off relation is recovered when one extracted unit has predicate token_f1 >=0.50 against the TO_indicator text and every annotated Arg0/Arg1/Arg2 present in that relation has token_f1 >=0.50 against a distinct extracted argument span in that same unit.
external_validation_sets.purpose: Measure whether the frozen evidence-unit extractor preserves relation-bearing predicate/argument content in held-out scientific sentences rather than winning SPARK through noisy overgeneration.

verdicts.PREDICATE_ARGUMENT_CERTIFICATE_VALIDATED: A SPARK calibration threshold exists and every SPARK held-out + FOBIE test gate passes.
verdicts.PREDICATE_ARGUMENT_CERTIFICATE_PARTIAL: Exactly one external gate family passes. No EXTRACT predicate/argument certificate experiment is authorized.
verdicts.PREDICATE_ARGUMENT_CERTIFICATE_REJECTED: No safe SPARK calibration threshold exists, or neither external gate family passes. No EXTRACT predicate/argument certificate experiment is authorized.

decision_boundary.if_validated: Checkpoint parser/model/data identities, selected SPARK threshold, held-out metrics, and extractor schema. Then open a separate EXTRACT design that substitutes this validated evidence-unit redundancy certificate into the accepted dynamic-swap/page-preservation/top-24 architecture.
decision_boundary.if_partial_or_rejected: Do not tune using EXTRACT teacher results. Reassess AMR or another materially different evidence-unit representation.
decision_boundary.never: Do not change production EXTRACT/VERIFY, start Wave 7B, train a parser/model, emit ontology/RDF output, promote fixed 20/4, or use EXTRACT teacher labels for threshold/rule selection.

independent_review_boundary.action: After this design becomes a durable pre-implementation checkpoint, re-read the review capsule and consume only a review checkpoint that explicitly applies to this exact design SHA. Do not block indefinitely if none exists.

rules: Do not alter EXTRACT science or output shape for semantic-control.
Do not emit RDF, ontology-native output, or SemanticObservationV1.
Integration remains downstream of a future genuinely accepted EXTRACT output checkpoint.

next_safe_action: CI-lock this design. Before implementation, re-read the independent-review capsule and consume any exact-SHA review checkpoint that applies. If none exists, implement only the external DEPENDENCY_PREDICATE_ARGUMENT_CERTIFICATE_VALIDATION_V1 harness/workflow exactly as frozen; do not read EXTRACT teacher fixtures.
